mapper.select: select kc.korean_card_id from korean_cards kc where exists ( select 1 from foreign_cards fc where fc.language_code = #{code} and fc.korean_card_id = kc.korean_card_id ) and exists ( select 1 from card_topics ct where ct.topic_id=#{topic} and ct.korean_card_id = kc.korean_card_id ) order by korean_word LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset};

select count(kc.korean_card_id) from korean_cards kc where exists ( select 1 from foreign_cards fc where fc.language_code = #{code} and fc.korean_card_id = kc.korean_card_id ) and exists ( select 1 from card_topics ct where ct.topic_id=#{topic} and ct.korean_card_id = kc.korean_card_id ) ;
